findings.reason: the honest change is to widen the one owned map and update its loud unpack sites; a parallel generated map must stay key-synced with the owner forever and is more surface than the edit it avoids.
findings.text: §12 adds a second generated index-metadata map (`GraphSchema.vector_index_filters` emitted as a sibling generated map, read by `ensure_vector_indexes`) alongside the map `scripts/gen_schema_context.py:148` already owns (`VECTOR_INDEXES`), both keyed by index name; the plan rejects widening the existing tuple on the grounds that four unpack sites break with a `ValueError` or "a silently shifted field", but widening a tuple value fails loudly at every `for name, (label, prop) in …` site (scripts/gen_schema_reference.py:64, imas_codex/graph/schema_context.py:200 and :264, imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py:42, imas_codex/llm/server.py:733) and each is a one-line update, so the sibling map trades four trivial edits for a permanent two-map key-sync invariant

duplicate_owner-1.reason: the generated schema_context_data module already carries index metadata as sibling name-keyed maps (VECTOR_INDEXES beside FULLTEXT_INDEXES), all written by the one generator from GraphSchema, so a filter-property map keyed by index name is another field of that single owner, not a second owner; widening the 3-tuple would churn five unpack sites to carry metadata only one index uses today, and the §12 node is already in flight on the sibling-map design

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §15 collapses five hand-written `CREATE VECTOR INDEX` statements (imas_codex/graph/build_dd.py:4694, dd_identifier_enrichment.py:356 and :707, dd_ids_enrichment.py:457, discovery/wiki/pipeline.py:1667) into the one owner `ensure_vector_indexes`, and §12/§16 add behaviour to that owner and the search builder instead of standing up parallel machinery.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §12 forks the schema-context generator's index-metadata channel instead of widening the one it owns.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; the sections that add surface account for it in their own text (§2 retires the prototype `class:`/`shots:`/`udpid:` keyword parking, §12 retires the `_search_code` facility `where_clauses` post-filter entry, §16 states nothing is added), and no section adds a CLI option, MCP view or refusal family.
